stories.title: « La digue a lâché en Allemagne » : la montée de l’extrême droite outre-Rhin inquiète sur la scène européenne

en.title: "The dike has broken in Germany": the rise of the far right across the Rhine worries the European scene
en.summary: Germany's European partners are concerned about the country prioritizing its own interests, which risks creating distrust and fear among neighboring nations.

stories.title: A Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, la France et le Canada affichent leur rapprochement face à Donald Trump

en.title: In Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, France and Canada display their rapprochement facing Donald Trump
en.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney visited the French archipelago to demonstrate coordinated diplomatic positioning by France and Canada in response to expansionist moves by the U.S. president.

stories.title: En Allemagne, l'extrême droite fête sa victoire dans le nord-est

en.title: In Germany, far-right celebrates victory in the northeast
en.summary: A far-right party achieved first place in elections in Mecklenburg-Western Pomerania with approximately 38 percent of votes, ahead of the social-democratic SPD at around 35 percent.

stories.title: Conférence de presse de Macron et Carney à Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon

en.title: Press conference by Macron and Carney in Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon
en.summary: President Macron reaffirmed French sovereignty over the archipelago and welcomed Canadian Prime Minister Carney for an unprecedented visit to demonstrate unity among Canada, France, and Europe against repeated U.S. pressures.

stories.title: Emmanuel Macron interviewé jeudi à 20 heures sur TF1 et France 2

en.title: Emmanuel Macron interviewed Thursday at 8 p.m. on TF1 and France 2
en.summary: The French president is scheduled for an interview addressing geopolitical tensions involving Russia and the Middle East, as well as energy crisis effects on French household finances.

stories.title: Menace russe, guerre au Moyen-Orient et prix des carburants… Emmanuel Macron sera au 20 heures de TF1 et France 2 jeudi

en.title: Russian threat, Middle East war and fuel prices... Emmanuel Macron will appear on TF1 and France 2 at 8 p.m. Thursday
en.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron will give a televised interview during prime time on Thursday evening following his press conference with political party leaders on Friday.

stories.title: Pêche, sécurité, énergie... La France et le Canada vont "travailler à un rapprochement", assure Emmanuel Macron depuis Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon

en.title: Fishing, security, energy... France and Canada will "work toward rapprochement", Emmanuel Macron assures from Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon
en.summary: French President Macron stated from Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon that France and Canada, as independent nations, will collaborate on multiple areas including fishing, security, and energy.

stories.title: A Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, la France et le Canada plaident pour un rapprochement « profond »

en.title: In Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, France and Canada argue for a "deep" rapprochement
en.summary: Emmanuel Macron stated alongside Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney that both nations are independent countries determined to remain so, speaking as neighboring states.

stories.title: La France et le Canada vont «travailler à un rapprochement» sur la pêche, la sécurité et l’énergie

en.title: France and Canada will "work toward rapprochement" on fishing, security and energy
en.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron hosted Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney in Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon for the first time. The two leaders demonstrated their sovereignty in response to Donald Trump.

stories.title: Le parti d'extrême droite AfD arrive en tête dans une région du nord-est de l'Allemagne, deux semaines après sa victoire historique en Saxe-Anhalt, d'après les premières estimations

en.title: Far-right AfD party comes first in north-eastern German region, two weeks after historic victory in Saxony-Anhalt
en.summary: The AfD secured a leading position in a northeastern German state election. The party came fourth in Berlin, where the radical left party outperformed the chancellor's party.

stories.title: Élections en Allemagne : le parti d'extrême droite AfD en tête

en.title: German elections: far-right AfD party leads
en.summary: Polling stations closed in Germany following two regional elections held on Sunday, September 20. Initial results showed the AfD in a leading position.

stories.title: Élections en Allemagne : la CDU menacée par l'extrême droite

en.title: German elections: CDU threatened by far-right
en.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz faces uncertain prospects ahead of Sunday regional elections following his conservative party's recent electoral defeat in Saxe-Anhalt, where the far-right achieved a decisive victory.

stories.title: « L'Europe doit affirmer sa puissance dans le spatial » (Hervé Derrey, PDG de Thales Alenia Space)

en.title: "Europe must assert its power in space" (Hervé Derrey, CEO of Thales Alenia Space)
en.summary: The head of Thales Alenia Space argues that Europe must demonstrate its capabilities in space, particularly through human spaceflight. He expects the December ministerial conference to outline ambitious goals and a strategy for more autonomous European exploration.

stories.title: Emmanuel Macron s'affiche avec une superbe brochette d'astronautes lors du sommet international sur l'espace

en.title: Emmanuel Macron poses with impressive group of astronauts at international space summit
en.summary: French President Macron was photographed with approximately 20 astronauts, primarily from Europe's 2022 cohort, alongside representatives from Canada, Turkey, the United Arab Emirates, and the United States.

stories.title: « C'est une évidence » que Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon est français, rappelle Emmanuel Macron face aux « idées étranges » de Donald Trump

en.title: "It is obvious" that Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon is French, Emmanuel Macron reminds in response to "strange ideas" from Donald Trump
en.summary: During a historic visit to Saint-Pierre-et-Miquelon, French President Macron and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney demonstrated unity between their countries against repeated criticism from Donald Trump.

stories.title: Fibre Excellence : l’État accorde un prêt de 2 millions d’euros pour l’usine de Saint-Gaudens

en.title: Fibre Excellence: The State grants a 2 million euro loan for the Saint-Gaudens plant
en.summary: The French state will provide a 2 million euro loan to Fibre Excellence Saint-Gaudens to support the pulp mill's operations during preparation for a takeover offer.
